id-Software / DOOM C · 1993

Linux port linuxdoom-1.10. ~132 C files, X11 + software raycaster, BSP walls → floors → sprites. Needs commercial WAD data. GPL re-release with IPX + serial netcode.

id-Software / DOOM-3 C++ · 2004

Fully 3D idTech 4 engine. ~1197 C++ files, OpenGL + stencil shadows, SCons + VS2010 + Xcode. Needs retail pak data. The only true-3D desktop match.

id / doom, idtech.space C · 1997

Pristine 1997 release, single commit “as released 1997-12-23”. linuxdoom-1.10 + sndserv, DOOMLIC.TXT, no GPL headers, no ipx/sersrc extras. Best for archaeology.

fps-asset-kit slice CC0 · in-game
